title: Vocabulary & Grammar Quiz — Unit 9B: How did you get there?
subtitle: Seasons, weather + Past simple questions (Did you …?)

words.sent: Flowers come out in ___, and the weather gets warmer.
We go to the beach in ___ because it is hot.
In ___, the leaves on the trees turn red and yellow.
It is very cold in ___ and sometimes it snows.
It’s 38 degrees today. It’s really ___.
Put on your coat. It’s very ___ outside.
It isn’t hot or cold. It’s a nice ___ day.
We went to the beach because it was ___ and hot.
It’s grey and ___ today. I can’t see the sun.
It was very ___, so my hat flew away.
Take an umbrella. It’s a ___ day.
It was cold and ___, so we made a snowman.
We stayed at home because of the ___.
The children played in the ___ and made a snowman.
There was a lot of ___ and the sea was dangerous.
I can see a big grey ___ in the sky.
We went to an ___ in Greece last summer.
We didn’t stay in a hotel. We decided to ___ in a garden.
We had a great ___ in Spain last year.
The tickets were only $4. They were very ___.

grammar.q: Where ___ you go on holiday last year?
grammar.note: Question: Where did + you + base verb
Yes / No question: Did + subject + base verb
After did use the base verb: get
Past question: did + subject + base verb
After did use the base verb: go

grammar.q: Did you like it?  Yes, I ___.
Did he stay in a hotel?  No, he ___.

grammar.note: The weather = it, past of be: was

grammar.q: ___ you see the film last night?
grammar.note: Past question: Did + subject + base verb

grammar.q: Who ___ you meet at the party?
grammar.note: Question: Who did + you + base verb

grammar.q: Where ___ she go on summer holiday?
grammar.note: Past question: did + subject + base verb
